messages.subject: d3heatmap output cluster
parts:
Hi Joe,

I'm using your d3heatmap and thank you for create such a convenient package for R users. I have a question: is there any way to get the clustering analysis result from the heat map? I want to user to be able to download the result for further analysis.

Thanks,
Mark

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: d3heatmap output cluster
parts: Not at the moment, but that's a good idea. What you can do for now is do the clustering outside of the d3heatmap call and pass the Rowv and Colv arguments in. Take a look at the source code of d3heatmap.R if you want to see how it's done.
